entries.why_here: The matched-pair measurement found: name_language: 2/40 flips (5.0%) versus null_name 0/40 (0.0%); exceeds the floor descriptively, but the intervals overlap; evidence remains inconclusive; absolute score movement is larger than its floor descriptively. gender_coded_name: 4/40 flips (10.0%) versus null_name 0/40 (0.0%); exceeds the floor descriptively, but the intervals overlap; evidence remains inconclusive; absolute score movement does not exceed its floor. university: 1/40 flips (2.5%) versus null_university 1/40 (2.5%); does not exceed the floor; no decision effect established; absolute score movement is larger than its floor descriptively. Unnecessary identity proxies are hidden regardless of whether an effect is established.
